simple.meaning: Beth-ham-Markaboth or Beth-Markaboth , a place in Palestine
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בֵּית הַמַּרְכָּבוֹת (H1024) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בֵּית הַמַּרְכָּבוֹת (Bêyth ham-Markâbôwth) means Beth-ham-Markaboth or Beth-Markaboth , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 1Chr 4 31.

definitions.short: Beth-ham-Markaboth or Beth-Markaboth , a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H1024. Beth Hammarkaboth or Beth Markaboth מַרְכָּבוֺת בֵּית proper name, of a location in Simeon ( place of chariots ) 1Chr 4:31 = הַֿמַּרְכָּבֹת׳בּ Josh 19:5 ; site unknown.
definitions.rootNote: or (shortened) בֵּית מַרְכָּבוֹת ; from 1004 and the plural of 4818 (with or without the article interposed); place of (the) chariots;
